_doc: Price strings and their expected euro cents. 'valid' and 'reject' must hold for BOTH the site JS parser (ceramicsdoronina/Stripe/js/money.js parseEuroToCents, which returns null) and the ODS build script (tools/build-catalogue.py cents(), which raises ValueError). 'numbers' are raw numeric ODS cells. 'jsOnly' formats are accepted by the browser parser only (display-side leniency); the build script is intentionally stricter. 'pythonQuirks' are accepted by cents() but rejected later by the generator (non-positive price is FATAL) or by JS.
